title: 'How do I accept Orange Money?'

import { DocsAgentIndex } from '@/components/docs/docs-agent-index';

<DocsAgentIndex />

Orange Money is available through **hosted checkout** and **payment links** where enabled for your organization. lomi. presents the correct instructions and provider handoff on the hosted page.

## Recommended integration

1. [Hosted checkout](/build/checkout) or [payment links](/build/payment-links) with `currency_code: "XOF"` (or applicable local currency).
2. Customer selects Orange Money on the provider picker.
3. Customer completes approval on device (USSD or app, rail-specific).
4. [Verify server-side](/build/guides/verify-payments) before fulfilling.

Direct `POST /charge/*` for Orange Money is not the default path—use hosted collection unless your account team documents otherwise.

## Async behavior

Treat Orange Money like other mobile-money rails: show **pending** in your UI until `transaction_status` is `completed`.
